title: A gate question that says a package was uploaded to PyPI is classed push by the word uploaded, so a wording choice about a release date is made blocking
goal: class_reasons in _tools/bl_authority.py no longer classes a gate question as push for the word uploaded when it names an upload date of a package release, for the word gitlab inside a kb topic path (gitlab/git-commit-paths-and-symlinks) or for a display-only question that names a push only to count or list the commits it carries (how many unpushed commits land lists before its push), while a question about uploading the repository's own commits to a remote, or about pushing, publishing or uploading a release, still classes push, and the repro command exits 0

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=a.class_reasons({'touches':[]},{'question':'PyPI lists 1.2.15, uploaded 2026-10-12 22:38 UTC, as latest: which version do the install facts state?','options':['keep 1.2.14','move to 1.2.15']});sys.exit(1 if c[0]=='push' else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=lambda q:a.class_reasons({'touches':[]},{'question':q,'options':['a','b']})[0];no=['PyPI lists 1.2.15, uploaded 2026-10-12 22:38 UTC, as latest: which version do the install facts state?','Where do the facts live: gitlab/git-commit-paths-and-symlinks or gitlab/git-test-repositories?','How many of the checkouts unpushed commits does land list by name before its push?'];yes=['May we upload the repositorys commits to the remote?','Should land push the branch to origin?','Do we publish the tree to GitHub?','May we upload 1.2.16 to PyPI?'];sys.exit(0 if all(c(q)!='push' for q in no) and all(c(q)=='push' for q in yes) else 1)

clauses.clause: class_reasons in _tools/bl_authority.py no longer classes a gate question as push for the word uploaded when it names an upload date of a package release, for the word gitlab inside a kb topic path (gitlab/git-commit-paths-and-symlinks) or for a display-only question that names a push only to count or list the commits it carries (how many unpushed commits land lists before its push), while a question about uploading the repository's own commits to a remote, or about pushing, publishing or uploading a release, still classes push

gates.question: Which shapes of wording does class_reasons stop classing as a push gate?
options: three shapes only: uploaded beside a date or time, a gitlab/ kb topic path, and a how-many or which count question whose push word is a noun after its or the; every other use of those words stays classed
the words themselves: uploaded and gitlab leave the word list for good
